checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Three separate files, not a collage.
All three are about 5:3 landscape, essentially the original.
The whole car is visible, but only because the frame is unchanged.
No padding was added and there is no text, but the required reframing was not done.

faults.what: None of the outputs is resized to 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16. All are landscape copies of the original.
The reply claims the car was reframed with extended street and sky, which does not match the images.
The 4:5 image has a slightly different color and sharpness than the others, which is a minor AI re-render difference.

summary: The three outputs are near-identical landscape copies of the original, so the requested square, 4:5 and 9:16 sizes were not delivered.
